minor: min-1 (doc, activation): the HARD PRECONDITION in the CLAUDE.md row and PR-body owner step 1 cannot be carried out as written. It asks for a structured-output smoke test 'through the deployed route' showing the [VISION_V2] candidates= line 'before the flip'. That line only appears after the flag is ON on web, because the flag is read per call and there is no per-request override. Ruling B3-R6(4) only asks for 'one live call with two photos'. Rewrite it either as an off-route smoke (the owner runs identify_products with the flag set in that one process env and two labelled photos) or as 'the first canary call is the smoke; unset on BadRequestError'.

min-2 (pin gap, MYEZ-001 core): the two load-bearing rules of VISION_PROMPT_V2 are not pinned. Z1 (delete the no-invention rule), Z2 ('numbered from 1') and Z3 ('1-based number') all SURVIVE the 105-node unit file. R3 pins six substrings, two negatives and a self-referential text == VISION_PROMPT_V2. The GREEN claim 'equals spec 2.2 char for char, sha 7d7f2c83...' is TRUE (re-measured), but no test enforces it. Fix: a VISION_PROMPT_SHA_ON pin, or the substrings '0-based', 'do NOT invent' and 'set confidence to "low"'.

min-3 (stated-limit gap, a consequence of ruling B3-R6(2)): measured with a probe on a two-photo request where both products are reported at image_index 0. V2 keeps ONE product (['A']), so the scan ends in need_second_product where V1 compared A vs B. If photo 2 is a close-up of one of them, V2 can turn a valid V1 pair into a same-identity pair. Neither the CLAUDE.md row nor the PR-body limits state this. Add it as a limit plus a canary reading, or re-rule the case where one paired index is empty.

min-4 (doc accuracy): 'The one client-visible value change: unknown confidence reads low' (CLAUDE.md row; PR-body limit 10) is false as worded. Other client-visible changes under ON: the identified set and the action (comparison / need_second_product / error); 503 LLM_UNAVAILABLE where base gave 500 on a None or refused reply; a 503 after 20 s where base waited unbounded; a null brand now reads 'Unknown'; stripped strings; and the full personalised result for signed-in scans.

min-5 (doc, test hazard understated): limit 14 names only the 3 camera_vision nodes. Measured with ENABLE_VISION_IDENTITY_V2=true in the runner env over the 21-file camera identity set: those 3 fail, and 53 nodes (56 attempts) in test_retro_w2_1, test_paid_route_metering, test_m13_26 and others now reach the real get_user_preferences and attempt a Supabase connection (blocked by the sentinel). With the flag OFF it is 3 attempts from 3 nodes. The netguard ratchet would report about 50 NEW egress nodes. Widen the limit, or add the flag to those files' env hygiene.

min-6 (pin gap, hand block-move XB1, the B3 analogue of the template's X19): moving the route's _compare_extra block (flag read + preferences read) above identify_products survives all 105 nodes. No row asserts that a non-delivery exit makes no preferences read. GREEN's placement is correct: probes on the 503, 500 and need_second_product exits all give prefs.calls == [], and those probes kill the mutant.

min-7 (pin gap, XB2): moving the finish_reason == 'length' check above the no-content check survives; a length reply with null content would then be exit 2 instead of the coded 503. GREEN's order is correct, and a probe kills the mutant.

min-8 (pin gap, XB3): moving the flag-first branch below the V1 content build survives (every image is base64-encoded twice). The 'FIRST statement of identify_products' claim is TRUE in the bytes but not pinned; a probe counting encode calls kills the mutant.

min-9 (pin gaps, observability): three mutants survive the unit file. Y1 drops _log_cache_telemetry from V2. Y2 widens except asyncio.TimeoutError to except Exception, which makes BadRequestError and 429 log as 'timed out' and would mislead the canary. Y3 ignores a refusal when content is a str. GREEN is correct on all three and probes kill them. Note: on a V2 expiry the route's existing ERROR line is '[IMAGE] Vision call failed: ' with an empty tail, so the [VISION_V2] timed-out WARNING is the only discriminator.

min-10 (doc, spend): limit 5 does not say that a placeholder pair ('Unknown Unknown Product vs ...') runs the full paid Serper + LLM pipeline and is delivered and billed until B2 flips several R-A2 windows later. Add one clause and a canary item.
Note (not a finding): X19 is B1's mutant id; wf_unit_green.js inserts it for every unit, so B3 has none. Three hand block-moves on B3's own seams (XB1-XB3) were applied instead.
